turn1_sqls.sql: SELECT q.questionid, q.questiontext FROM Question q WHERE q.questiontext LIKE '%mental%' OR q.questiontext LIKE '%condition%' OR q.questiontext LIKE '%disorder%' OR q.questiontext LIKE '%treatment%' OR q.questiontext LIKE '%diagnosis%' OR q.questiontext LIKE '%currently%'
SELECT DISTINCT a.AnswerText FROM Answer a WHERE a.QuestionID = 2 LIMIT 30
SELECT q.questionid, q.questiontext FROM Question q

SELECT
  gender_ans.AnswerText AS gender,
  CASE
    WHEN CAST(age_ans.AnswerText AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 18 AND 34 THEN '18-34'
    WHEN CAST(age_ans.AnswerText AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 35 AND 49 THEN '35-49'
    WHEN CAST(age_ans.AnswerText AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 50 AND 65 THEN '50-65'
  END AS age_group,
  COUNT(*) AS total_respondents,
  SUM(CASE WHEN mh_ans.AnswerText = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS yes_count,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN mh_ans.AnswerText = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) AS burden_rate
FROM Answer age_ans
JOIN Answer gender_ans ON age_ans.UserID = gender_ans.UserID AND gender_ans.QuestionID = 2
JOIN Answer mh_ans ON age_ans.UserID = mh_ans.UserID
JOIN Question mh_q ON mh_ans.QuestionID = mh_q.questionid
WHERE age_ans.QuestionID = 1
  AND CAST(age_ans.AnswerText AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 18 AND 65
  AND gender_ans.AnswerText IN ('Male', 'Female')
  AND mh_q.questiontext LIKE '%mental health condition%'
  AND CASE
    WHEN CAST(age_ans.AnswerText AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 18 AND 34 THEN '18-34'
    WHEN CAST(age_ans.AnswerText AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 35 AND 49 THEN '35-49'
    WHEN CAST(age_ans.AnswerText AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 50 AND 65 THEN '50-65'
  END IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY gender_ans.AnswerText, age_group

SELECT DISTINCT mh_q.questionid, mh_q.questiontext, a.AnswerText
FROM Question mh_q
JOIN Answer a ON a.QuestionID = mh_q.questionid
WHERE (mh_q.questiontext LIKE '%mental%' OR mh_q.questiontext LIKE '%condition%')
LIMIT 20

SELECT q.questionid, q.questiontext, COUNT(DISTINCT a.AnswerText) as distinct_answers
FROM Question q
JOIN Answer a ON a.QuestionID = q.questionid
GROUP BY q.questionid, q.questiontext
ORDER BY q.questionid

SELECT q.questionid, q.questiontext, a.AnswerText, COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM Question q
JOIN Answer a ON a.QuestionID = q.questionid
WHERE a.AnswerText IN ('Yes', 'No')
GROUP BY q.questionid, q.questiontext, a.AnswerText
ORDER BY q.questionid, a.AnswerText

SELECT
  p.gender,
  CASE
    WHEN (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p.birthdate)) BETWEEN 18 AND 34 THEN '18-34'
    WHEN (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p.birthdate)) BETWEEN 35 AND 49 THEN '35-49'
    WHEN (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p.birthdate)) BETWEEN 50 AND 65 THEN '50-65'
  END AS age_group,
  p.patient,
  SUM(c.TOTAL) AS total_claims
FROM patients p
JOIN claims c ON c.PATIENT = p.patient
WHERE p.deathdate IS NULL
  AND p.gender IN ('F', 'M')
  AND (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p.birthdate)) BETWEEN 18 AND 65
GROUP BY p.patient, p.gender, age_group
HAVING age_group IS NOT NULL
